rows.en: Garyud: "We must hold out until Ciel and the others succeed.
Advancing recklessly would be dangerous."
Reduce: "We are at a disadvantage. Being surrounded would make it worse."
Arthur: "I think this is as far as we can go.
Any farther would be dangerous.
Touya, you're the one I'm most worried about.
Please be careful."
Touya: "I know!"
Zigrim Soldier F: "Th-They've come out!
There are Spirit Mechs among them, just as we thought!"
Grad: "In this battle, I have no way back.
But that is my own personal problem.
You don't need to force yourselves to follow me..."
Zigrim Soldier E: "We have already made up our minds."
Zigrim Soldier F: "Our lives are with you, Major."
Grad: "Of course. Very well, shall we go?"
Zigrim Soldier E: "Yes, sir!"
Zigrim Soldier F: "To victory!"
Touya: "Come on, aren't they done yet...?"
Ymir: "Explosion confirmed!
It seems Ciel and the others have succeeded!"
Touya: "All right! Now we can go all out!"
Yamato: "Don't let your guard down!"
Grad: "Heh... Just as I thought."
Touya: "Hmm? What's going on? Don't they seem awfully calm?"
Garyud: "Could it be...? No, we must press on for now!"
Touya: "What's the plan?"
Garyud: "We will break through the enemy ranks.
Our target is Grad Burgley's Griol.
I will lead the charge. Everyone, follow me!"
Touya: "Hey, are you serious...?
But... I guess that's our only option!"
Zigrim Soldier: "H-He's a monster!"
Grad: "Do not be afraid! The enemy has only a few mechs.
There is nothing to fear!"
Garyud: "Grad Burgley.
To think we would meet on the battlefield once more."
Grad: "How ironic that two men who do not wish to fight
should cross blades."
Garyud: "Then will you not lower your blade?"
Grad: "I cannot."
Garyud: "...I see. Then let us settle
this here."
Grad: "Gladly. Here I come!"
Ymir: "Explosion confirmed! It seems Ciel and the others
have succeeded!"
Yamato: "...Though we're already in the middle of a melee..."
Touya: "Whatever's happening, let's defeat their commander."
Garyud: "So we are continuing where we left off."
Grad: "...Yes."
Garyud: "...Does this war mean so much that you would go this far?"
Grad: "..."
Garyud: "It seems you have some reason you cannot retreat."
Grad: "Yes... For those I must protect...
Enough questions. Come at me."
Garyud: "...Understood."
Grad: "Oh, I sense strong Prana... I see. You are the boy
who activated Rayblade."
Touya: "I'm not 'the boy.' My name is Touya."
Grad: "Hehe... My apologies. Then, Touya,
let me see how strong you are..."
Touya: "Are you seriously planning to risk your life
in a war of aggression like this?"
Grad: "I am a soldier too, after all.
But I did not want to fight in this fashion."
Touya: "Then..."
Grad: "However, I have no choice but to fight
for those I must protect, regardless of my own wishes."
Touya: "What... does that mean?"
Grad: "...It seems I have said too much.
Now, show me your strength."
Grad: "Here... I cannot afford to lose here!!"
Touya: "What?!"
Grad: "Raaaaaaaagh!"
Touya: "Wh-What are you going to do?!"
Grad: "...Forgive me. I cannot simply retreat.
I will take this castle with me."
Yamato: "H-He's planning to self-destruct?!"
Touya: "You're kidding! What the hell would that accomplish?!"
Grad: "...Thora, Kururu, forgive me...?!"
Touya: "Th-That's..."
Kasumi: "P-Please stop!"
Grad: "A Spirit Mech... There was another one...?
Run if you don't want to die."
Kasumi: "How... How can you treat your own life
so carelessly?!"
Grad: "This is the only way to save the lives of those...
those I care about."
Kasumi: "..."
Grad: "That is why I..."
Kasumi: "You're wrong. You're wrong!
Even if what you do saves the person you care about,
what about the person who matters most to them?!"
Grad: "..."
Kasumi: "You're only thinking about yourself.
Maybe you'll be satisfied, but have you thought about
the sorrow of those you leave behind?!
I've seen that sorrow up close.
Their heart is hurt so terribly, and they keep shedding invisible tears...
You have no right to do that!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Kasumi..."
Grad: "...You have a pure heart. But I
cannot retreat. Even if I am condemned as arrogant,
as long as Thora and Kururu live..."
Kasumi: "No!"
Grad: "Then I will eliminate you first!"
Grad: "Raaaaaagh!"
Kasumi: "P-Please stooooop!!"
Grad: "Ghh... If I had been in perfect condition...
No, I suppose this is my limit...
Forgive me, Thora, Kururu..."
Touya: "Kasumi! Are you okay?!"
Kasumi: "...No... Touya-chan, I..."
Touya: "Calm down!"
Kasumi: "I... A person... I..."
Touya: "Kasumi..."
Ciel: "Father!"
Garyud: "Ah, you're safe too."
Ai: "Oh! Isn't that Orbest?! Could it be Kasumi?!"
Kasumi: "..."
Ai: "Kasumi...?
Hey, what's happened to you?!"
Touya: "Well..."
Fain: "What?! Sir Grad?!"
Ai: "H-Hey, is that person really dead?"
Touya: "I don't know. But after an explosion like that,
the chances of him being alive..."
Clovis: "Hey, Touya. We've crossed that boundary line
we were told about, haven't we?"
Touya: "Oh..."
Clovis: "...I was an idiot to follow your orders."
Arthur: "...We have crossed the boundary line."
Yamato: "Touya! What are you doing?!"
Arthur: "...There's nothing we can do now.
This looks like it's going to be a hard fight..."
Yamato: "Hey! Are you out of your mind?! We were told
not to cross it!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Honestly! Don't come crying to me!"
